name: 74066 · Sapulpa, OK
findings: ZIP 74066 (Sapulpa) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74066 (Sapulpa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
